The '''2024–25 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of South Carolina]] during the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by third-year head coach [[Lamont Paris]] and played their home games at [[Colonial Life Arena]] located in [[Columbia, South Carolina]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]].

South Carolina finished bottom of the table in the SEC and was one of only two SEC teams to not make the NCAA tournament (the other being [[2024–25 LSU Tigers men's basketball team|LSU]]).

==Previous season==
The [[2023–24 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|Gamecocks]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 26–8, 13–5 in [[2023–24 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2024 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they beat [[2023–24 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] in the second round before falling to [[2023–24 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]] in the quarterfinals. The Gamecocks earned an at-large bid to the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]], their first since 2017. However, they would fall in the first round to [[2023–24 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]], 87–73.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Athletics |first=South Carolina |date=2024-03-22 |title=No. 16 South Carolina reflects on historic season after tough tournament exit |url=https://www.foxcarolina.com/2024/03/22/no-16-south-carolina-reflects-historic-season-after-tough-tournament-exit/ |access-date=August 2, 2024 |website=foxcarolina.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=2023-24 South Carolina Gamecocks Men's Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/south-carolina/men/2024-schedule.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=August 2, 2024}}</ref>

On October 14, 2024 the SEC released their preseason media poll.
